title: Methyl 3-Bromo-4,5-dihydroxybenzoate Attenuates Inflammatory Bowel Disease by Regulating TLR/NF-kappaB Pathways.
authors: Huang, Jing; Li, Lei; Xu, Liyan; Feng, Lixin; Wang, Yuxin; Sik, Attila Gabor; Jin, Meng; Wang, Rongchun; Liu, Kechun; Li, Xiaobin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究海洋来源化合物MBD通过TLR/NF-kB通路缓解斑马鱼炎症性肠病，虽含分子对接但核心为湿实验与通路表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is characterized by uncontrolled, chronic relapsing inflammation in the gastrointestinal tract and has become a global healthcare problem. Here, we aimed to illustrate the anti-inflammatory activity and the underlying mechanism of methyl 3-bromo-4,5-dihydroxybenzoate (MBD), a compound derived from marine organisms, especially in IBD, using a zebrafish model. The results indicated that MBD could inhibit the inflammatory responses induced by CuSO(4), tail amputation and LPS in zebrafish. Furthermore, MBD notably inhibited the intestinal migration of immune cells, enhanced the integrity of the gut mucosal barrier and improved intestinal peristalsis function in a zebrafish IBD model induced by trinitro-benzene-sulfonic acid (TNBS). In addition, MBD could inhibit ROS elevation induced by TNBS. Network pharmacology analysis, molecular docking, transcriptomics sequencing and RT-PCR were conducted to investigate the potential mechanism. The results showed that MBD could regulate the TLR/NF-kappaB pathways by inhibiting the mRNA expression of TNF-alpha, NF-kappaB, IL-1, IL-1beta, IL6, AP1, IFNgamma, IKKbeta, MyD88, STAT3, TRAF1, TRAF6, NLRP3, NOD2, TLR3 and TLR4, and promoting the mRNA expression of IL4, IkappaBalpha and Bcl-2. In conclusion, these findings indicate that MBD could be a potential candidate for the treatment of IBD.
abstract_zh: 炎症性肠病（IBD）以胃肠道不受控制的慢性复发性炎症为特征，已成为全球性医疗保健问题。本研究旨在利用斑马鱼模型，阐明源自海洋生物的化合物3-溴-4,5-二羟基苯甲酸甲酯（MBD）的抗炎活性及其潜在机制，尤其是在IBD中的作用。结果表明，MBD能够抑制斑马鱼中由CuSO(4)、尾部截断和LPS诱导的炎症反应。此外，在由三硝基苯磺酸（TNBS）诱导的斑马鱼IBD模型中，MBD显著抑制了免疫细胞的肠道迁移，增强了肠道黏膜屏障的完整性，并改善了肠道蠕动功能。另外，MBD还能抑制TNBS诱导的ROS升高。为探究潜在机制，进行了网络药理学分析、分子对接、转录组测序和RT-PCR。结果显示，MBD可通过抑制TNF-alpha、NF-kappaB、IL-1、IL-1beta、IL6、AP1、IFNgamma、IKKbeta、MyD88、STAT3、TRAF1、TRAF6、NLRP3、NOD2、TLR3和TLR4的mRNA表达，并促进IL4、IkappaBalpha和Bcl-2的mRNA表达，来调节TLR/NF-kappaB通路。总之，这些发现表明MBD可能成为治疗IBD的潜在候选药物。
